Interface HeiGuiScreenHelperAccessor

public interface HeiGuiScreenHelperAccessor
Exposes HEI's integration registrations so detached helpers can use the same mod integrations. Returned collections are live, not defensive copies; the scope copies their entries into its helper during initialization on the client thread.
